name: motif_parsimony_status
description:
Read a Proposal's Parsimony status. Says whether Parsimony has measured a Proposal's candidate after its Trial: not set up, not yet run, queued, running, ready, stale or failed, with a Grammar group and a Text group. It reads stored jobs and Reports only and never starts a run. Parsimony is advisory and never changes the Trial, Readiness or Apply.
Command: parsimony status. Agent class: Read.
ProposalId: The Proposal to read the status of.

project.description: Known project name or recorded .fwdata path.
